decisions.reason: The copper-coated glass substrates under the publicly announced ACT initiative are a flagship of the firm's shift toward higher-value 3D-integration and high-frequency applications, so dropping them would write off visible investment and contradict its stated direction.

VLIS was only launched in 2024 with its own page and is presented as a next-generation flagship for semiconductor packaging, so heavy public commitment and an early stage that still excuses weak results make persistence very likely.
